title: ⭐D6-17A RP 미아 신고 (대화형·관리사무소)
q: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. There is a lost child near the main entrance of a shopping mall. Call the management office, explain the situation, and ask three or four questions about what to do.

title: D6-17B 낯선 사람 도운 경험 (아묻따 #8)
q: Have you ever helped a stranger? Tell me what happened, and how you helped them.

title: 2-1 미아 발견
q: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You've found a little child who is lost at a shopping mall. Talk to the child, ask three or four questions to find out what happened, and help the child find their parents.

title: 2-3 분실 경험
q: Have you ever lost something important? Tell me the whole story. Where were you, what did you lose, what did you do to find it, and how did it all end?

title: 2-2 신고
q: I'm sorry, but there's a problem I need you to resolve. You couldn't find the lost child's parents. Call the information center, explain the situation, and ask them to help you find the parents.

title: 2-4 AI 변화
